title: bezorg completion manifest
description: Written as <local><done_suffix> after every file in a bezorg job has its final name. The default suffix is .bezorg-done.json. The Go type is transfer.Manifest.

job_id.description: Daemon job id. Empty for a foreground bezorg run.

external_id.description: Caller correlation id. Empty when the job did not set one.

remote.description: Remote path, or a URL with userinfo removed. Never contains credentials.

completed_at.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp of when the manifest was published.

files.description: Every file in the delivery, sorted by path.

path.description: Path relative to the directory containing the manifest, with forward slashes.
